# Thom Ives, Ph.D.

> Full-Stack AI Applications Architect and Data Scientist with 30+ years across consulting, enterprise R&D, and founder-owned ventures. Currently a Senior AI Consultant at Unify Consulting, serving as the technical lead and architect behind Unify's emerging AI product line — turning executive product vision into real, secure, privately-hosted applications in days rather than months, alongside internal AI-enablement programs that move AI-hesitant professionals into confident, responsible use of AI. Founder of PostalDataPI (agent-native postal-code API) and retained Webmaster for Fungaia Coffee Company (formerly Part Owner and Director of Technology, December 2025 – July 2026). Open to consulting engagements and senior architect / principal roles.

## About

- **Name:** Thom Ives, Ph.D.

## Current Engagements

- [Senior AI Consultant at Unify Consulting](https://www.linkedin.com/in/thomives/) — **technical lead and architect** of each application across Unify's emerging AI product line. Turning product vision and early mockups into real, secure, privately-hosted applications in days rather than months, working alongside AI agents. Established a reusable foundation that gets each new product from concept to a working live app fast and safely. Portfolio in flight spans the full sales-to-delivery lifecycle: a **Revenue Intelligence Engine** with its first AI agent in production; a **Business Development suite** entering a disciplined, budget-capped pilot; **internal AI-enablement programs** — tutored, hands-on learning ladders (Class → three Labs → Capstone) that move AI-hesitant professionals into confident, responsible use of AI; and several more products in early form. Beyond building: scoping bounded pilots, protecting adoption and spend, and holding a clear line between what's genuinely live and what's illustrative. Common architectural pattern: modular adapter-based integration to systems of record (Salesforce CRM live), LLM agent-evaluation frameworks with human-in-the-loop safety invariants, controlled-access cloud-native deployment with federated identity, and a multi-agent development methodology spanning research, drafting, and adversarial review. The throughline is Unify's own thesis: build AI products, prove them on ourselves, then sell them.
- **Prior Unify engagement (Nov 2025 – Jun 2026): Microsoft ABM AI Team.** Delivered a Microsoft Fabric AI Functions classifier (gpt-4.1-mini) over millions of free-text seller-disposition records, plus a curated PySpark knowledge base against the team's recommendation-outcomes Delta lakehouse.

## Ventures

- [PostalDataPI](https://postaldatapi.com) — global postal-code validation and enrichment API covering 246 countries + territories (1M+ postal codes) at sub-5ms response. Founder and owner. Built agent-native from day one: first-party Python, Node, and MCP SDKs, OpenAPI 3.0, and `llms.txt` for direct AI-agent consumption. Self-hosted Node 22 / Next.js 15 API surface with in-memory cache; Vercel for marketing site, account dashboard, OAuth, and Stripe webhooks; Neon PostgreSQL with Drizzle ORM. Transparent single-tier pricing at $0.000028/query.
- [Fungaia Coffee Company](https://fungaiacoffeeco.com) — functional-mushroom coffee and cacao D2C brand based in Boise, Idaho. **Retained Webmaster from July 2026 — continuing service relationship after transitioning from Part Owner and Director of Technology (December 2025 – July 2026).** Built and now maintain the full Next.js e-commerce stack on Vercel, integrating Square (payments, orders, inventory), Shippo (real-time shipping rates), Resend (transactional email), and Printful (print-on-demand merch).
- Integrated Machine Learning & AI (2018–2022) — founded; grew worldwide mentoring community to 65K+ followers via blog posts, bi-weekly tech chats, keynote talks, and ML book reviews for Packt. Continuing lighter-touch mentorship since shifting primary focus to consulting and PostalDataPI.
